title: PracticePay Payment Reset: Rate Cut for the Plan's Late-Fee Record
content:
**Rule.** The payment-record rate cut of a PracticePay Patient Financing payment reset counts the late fees on the plan dated within the last 12 months: none gives 1.00 percentage point, exactly one gives 0.5 percentage points, and two or more give 0; a window of the last N months here covering entries dated fewer than N whole months before the reset date, a month being whole once the reset date's day of the month has reached the entry's day of the month.

| Late fees on the plan within the last 12 months | Rate cut (percentage points) |
|---|---|
| 0 | 1.00 |
| 1 | 0.5 |
| 2 or more | 0 |

*Window edge (hypothetical, reset on 8 July).* A late fee dated 9 July of the year before is 11 whole months back and counts; one dated 8 July of the year before is 12 whole months back and does not.
